exposure: Instructional program based on health belief model
cohort: The study included 60 primiparous women in their 26-30th week of pregnancy who visited Bandar Abbas Healthcare Centers.
finding: An instructional program based on the health belief model significantly improved pregnant women's awareness, perceived sensitivity, intensity, benefits, barriers, self-efficacy, and performance related to delivery choice.
mod_finding: In the experimental group, 30% of subjects had a natural delivery, indicating the program's influence on the choice of delivery type.
